example.title: Kansas Homestead of Thomas McQuill(i)an, farmhouse
example.place: Willow Springs vicinity, Douglas County, KS

brief: Symmetrical two-storey I-house of rough-faced buff limestone laid in irregular courses, with a small centre wall gable over the upstairs window and a side-gable roof in tan-brown asphalt shingle. A little gabled entry porch on two white Doric columns set on stone piers shelters the door, with bright green-painted steps; one-over-one windows in green-painted frames. A massive rubble-stone chimney climbs the outside of the west gable end, and a two-storey frame addition from 1900 in cream siding with its own brick chimney extends from the rear. Gravel drip strip, white downspouts, a flag on the porch post and a weathered barn beyond the yard.
